definition_en: a public road in a town with buildings along it, or the life lived on such roads
core_image: 两侧排着房子、店铺和路灯的一条城市道路
scene: 孩子们在街上踢球。The children played football in the street.
sceneCN: 这里 street 是「街道」（第 1 个义项）；句意：孩子们在街上踢球。

senses.title: A town road
senses.definition: a road in a town, with buildings along its sides
senses.definitionCN: 城镇中两旁有建筑的道路
senses.example: The children played football in the street.
senses.exampleCN: 孩子们在街上踢球。
senses.why: This is the paved way itself.
senses.whyCN: 这是铺出来的道路本身。

senses.title: Life outdoors
senses.definition: the public space of a town, or life lived there
senses.definitionCN: 城镇的公共空间，或在那里度过的生活
senses.example: Many people are living on the streets.
senses.exampleCN: 许多人在街头流浪。
senses.why: The road becomes a place where life happens.
senses.whyCN: 道路在这里成了生活发生的场所。

senses.title: Part of a name
senses.definition: used in the names of roads and places
senses.definitionCN: 用于道路与地点的名称中
senses.example: She works on Wall Street.
senses.exampleCN: 她在华尔街工作。
senses.why: A street name can stand for a whole trade.
senses.whyCN: 一条街名可以代表整个行业。

intro.en: Street comes from Latin strata, a paved road, through Old English stræt.
intro.cn: street 经由古英语 stræt，来自拉丁语 strata，意为铺砌的道路。

items.en: Strata meant a paved road.
items.cn: strata 意为铺砌的道路。

items.en: Stræt named a Roman road.
items.cn: stræt 指罗马人修筑的道路。

items.en: Strete came to mean any town road.
items.cn: 中古英语 strete 泛指城镇道路。

items.en: Street named the public life of a town.
items.cn: street 也开始指城镇的公共生活。

items.en: Street names stood for trades, as with Wall Street.
items.cn: 街名可以代指行业，如华尔街。

note.en: Street is compared with look-alike words and with words for roads.
note.cn: 把 street 与形近词以及表示道路的词作比较。

normalIntro.en: Street is stone laid down so a town can move.
normalIntro.cn: street 是铺下来的石头，让整座城镇得以流动。

normal.en: The shop is across the street.
We met at the street corner.
Street lights came on at dusk.
The main street was full of people.
He grew up on the streets.

abstract.en: A street is a river made of stone.
abstract.cn: 街道是一条石头做的河。

abstract.en: Every street carries two stories, one each way.
abstract.cn: 每条街都载着两个方向的故事。

abstract.en: The street belongs to everyone and no one.
abstract.cn: 街道属于所有人，也不属于任何人。

examples.en: The children played football in the street.
examples.cn: 孩子们在街上踢球。

examples.en: Many people are living on the streets.
examples.cn: 许多人在街头流浪。

examples.en: She works on Wall Street.
examples.cn: 她在华尔街工作。

dict_mnemonic.text: street 来自「铺好的路」；两旁有房子的路是街道，路上的公共生活是街头，用作街名时还能代表一个行业。

root: 来自拉丁语 strata（铺砌的路），经古英语 stræt 进入英语；由罗马人修筑的石路，泛化为城镇街道，再引申为街头生活与街名代称。

sensesIntro.en: Street is a paved town road, the public life on it, and a name that can stand for a trade.
sensesIntro.cn: street 是铺好的城镇道路、路上的公共生活，以及能代指行业的街名。

core.en: Stone paving between two rows of houses.
core.cn: 两排房子之间铺着石头的路。

branches.en: Cars pass between the buildings.
A musician plays on the pavement.
A name plate marks the road.
The road becomes a stage.
A street name can hold a whole trade.
branches.cn: 一个街名可以装下整个行业。

intro.en: Street forms a plural and compounds with everyday words.
intro.cn: street 有复数形式，并能与日常词构成复合词。

latinIntro.en: The Latin source is strata, a paved road.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语来源是 strata，意为铺砌的道路。

items.meaning: knowing how to survive in a city

items.example: They met at the street corner.

items.meaning: the chief street of a town

latinEntries.example: The Latin strata gave us street.
latinEntries.exampleCN: 拉丁语 strata 给了我们 street 这个词。

definition_en: the physical power of a body, a strong quality, or the degree to which something can resist force
core_image: 一个人绷紧手臂，把重物稳稳举过头顶
scene: 他需要力气才能搬动那块石头。He needed strength to move the stone.
sceneCN: 这里 strength 是「力量」（第 1 个义项）；句意：他需要力气才能搬动那块石头。

senses.title: Physical power
senses.definition: the physical power of a person or animal
senses.definitionCN: 人或动物身体的力量
senses.example: He needed strength to move the stone.
senses.exampleCN: 他需要力气才能搬动那块石头。
senses.why: This is power in the muscles.
senses.whyCN: 这是肌肉里的力量。

senses.title: A strong point
senses.definition: a quality or ability in which someone is strong
senses.definitionCN: 某人擅长的地方或优势
senses.example: Patience is her greatest strength.
senses.exampleCN: 耐心是她最大的长处。
senses.why: Power can also live in character.
senses.whyCN: 力量也可以存在于品格之中。

senses.title: Resistance to force
senses.definition: how well a material or argument holds up
senses.definitionCN: 材料或论点承受压力的程度
senses.example: Engineers tested the strength of the bridge.
senses.exampleCN: 工程师测试了这座桥的强度。
senses.why: The idea of power moves into objects.
senses.whyCN: 力量的概念被移到了物体上。

intro.en: Strength comes from Old English strengþu, physical power.
intro.cn: strength 来自古英语 strengþu，意为身体的力量。

items.en: Strengþu meant bodily power.
items.cn: strengþu 指身体的力量。

items.en: It shared a root with strong.
items.cn: 它与 strong 共用一个词根。

items.en: Strengthe kept the sense of might.
items.cn: 中古英语 strengthe 仍指力量。

items.en: Strength also named a person's good quality.
items.cn: strength 也开始指人的长处。

items.en: It came to measure materials and arguments.
items.cn: 它又被用来衡量材料与论点的强度。

note.en: Strength is compared with look-alike words and with words for power.
note.cn: 把 strength 与形近词以及表示力量的词作比较。

entries.definition: the measure from end to end
the ability to act or control

normalIntro.en: Strength is power in muscle, in character, and in stone.
normalIntro.cn: strength 是肌肉里的力量、品格里的力量，也是石头里的力量。

normal.en: He lifted the box with great strength.
normal.cn: 他用很大的力气抬起箱子。

normal.en: She found inner strength in hard times.
normal.cn: 艰难时她找到了内心的力量。

normal.en: The team is back at full strength.
Honesty is one of his strengths.
The wall has great strength.

abstract.en: Strength is the quiet behind a steady hand.
abstract.cn: 力量，是稳稳的手背后那份安静。

abstract.en: Some strength is only found when it is needed.
abstract.cn: 有些力量，只有在需要时才被找到。

abstract.en: Stone strength is patience under weight.
abstract.cn: 石头的强度，是承重时的耐心。

examples.en: He needed strength to move the stone.
examples.cn: 他需要力气才能搬动那块石头。

examples.en: Patience is her greatest strength.
examples.cn: 耐心是她最大的长处。

examples.en: Engineers tested the strength of the bridge.
examples.cn: 工程师测试了这座桥的强度。

dict_mnemonic.text: strength 是 strong 的名词；肌肉里的力量是力气，人擅长的地方是长处，材料扛得住是强度。

root: 来自古英语 strengþu（力量），与 strong 同源；由身体的力量，引申为人的长处与优势，再用于材料、论点等可承受压力的程度。

sensesIntro.en: Strength is muscle power, a personal strong point, and the power of a thing to resist force.
sensesIntro.cn: strength 是肌肉的力量、个人的长处，以及物体抵抗外力的能力。

core.en: A heavy stone held steady above the head.
core.cn: 一块重石被稳稳举过头顶。

branches.en: Arms tighten and the load rises.
A calm word wins a hard day.
branches.cn: 一句平静的话撑过艰难的一天。

branches.en: A bridge holds in the wind.
What the body learns, the character keeps.
branches.cn: 身体学会的，品格会留下。

branches.en: A strong argument and a strong beam both resist pressure.
branches.cn: 有力的论点和坚固的梁，都扛得住压力。

intro.en: Strength forms a plural and connects to strong and strengthen.
intro.cn: strength 有复数，并与 strong、strengthen 相连。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin root; the word is Germanic.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词没有拉丁词根，属于日耳曼语来源。

items.example: The team played at full strength.

definition_en: to make something stronger, more solid, or more effective
core_image: 在一根柱子上再加一道支撑，让它更稳
scene: 锻炼能增强肌肉。Exercise can strengthen your muscles.
sceneCN: 这里 strengthen 是「增强」（第 1 个义项）；句意：锻炼能增强肌肉。

senses.title: Make physically stronger
senses.definition: to make a body, structure, or material stronger
senses.definitionCN: 使身体、结构或材料更强
senses.example: Exercise can strengthen your muscles.
senses.exampleCN: 锻炼能增强肌肉。
senses.why: This is added power in the body.
senses.whyCN: 这是给身体增加力量。

senses.title: Make a bond firmer
senses.definition: to make a relationship, position, or system more secure
senses.definitionCN: 使关系、地位或体系更稳固
senses.example: The visit strengthened ties between the two cities.
senses.exampleCN: 这次访问加强了两座城市之间的联系。
senses.why: Bonds can be braced like beams.
senses.whyCN: 关系也能像梁一样被加固。

senses.title: Make more convincing
senses.definition: to make an argument, feeling, or effect stronger
senses.definitionCN: 使论点、感受或效果更有力
senses.example: The new evidence strengthened her case.
senses.exampleCN: 新证据使她的论据更有力。
senses.why: A case stands like a structure and can be braced.
senses.whyCN: 论据像建筑一样立着，也能被加固。

intro.en: Strengthen is strength plus the verb ending -en.
intro.cn: strengthen 由 strength 加动词后缀 -en 构成。

items.en: Strengþu named power.
items.cn: strengþu 指力量。

items.en: Strengthen meant to give strength.
items.cn: 中古英语 strengthen 意为赋予力量。

items.en: It described making the body stronger.
items.cn: 它用来描写让身体更强壮。

items.en: It spread to buildings and systems.
items.cn: 词义扩展到建筑与制度。

items.en: It also came to mean making a case stronger.
items.cn: 也表示让论据更有力。

note.en: Strengthen is compared with look-alike words and with words for making stronger.
note.cn: 把 strengthen 与形近词以及表示加强的词作比较。

entries.definition: the measure from end to end

normalIntro.en: Strengthen is the act of adding strength to something already standing.
normalIntro.cn: strengthen 是给已经立着的东西再加一份力量。

normal.en: Walking strengthens the legs.
The two countries strengthened their ties.
A second lock strengthened the door.
The news strengthened her resolve.
normal.cn: 这个消息增强了她的决心。

normal.en: They strengthened the bridge with steel.
normal.cn: 他们用钢材加固了桥梁。

abstract.en: To strengthen is to help something hold its ground.
abstract.cn: 加强，就是帮某物站稳。

abstract.en: Bonds grow stronger by being used.
abstract.cn: 关系越用越牢固。

abstract.en: A brave choice strengthens the one who makes it.
abstract.cn: 勇敢的选择，会让做出选择的人更强。

examples.en: Exercise can strengthen your muscles.
examples.cn: 锻炼能增强肌肉。

examples.en: The visit strengthened ties between the two cities.
examples.cn: 这次访问加强了两座城市之间的联系。

examples.en: The new evidence strengthened her case.
examples.cn: 新证据使她的论据更有力。

dict_mnemonic.text: strengthen 是 strength 加 -en，也就是「使有力量」；肌肉变强是增强，关系变牢是巩固，论据变硬是更有力。

root: 由 strength（力量）加动词后缀 -en 构成；从给身体增加力量，扩展到加固结构与关系，再用于增强论据、信心与效果。

sensesIntro.en: Strengthen adds power to a body, firmness to a bond, and weight to an argument.
sensesIntro.cn: strengthen 给身体加力量，给关系加牢固，给论据加分量。

core.en: A second beam braced against the first.
core.cn: 第二根梁撑住第一根。

branches.en: A runner adds one more hill.
Two towns sign a new agreement.
A document supports the claim.
Practice strengthens both body and trust.
branches.cn: 练习既强身体，也强信任。

branches.en: Proof strengthens a promise between people.
branches.cn: 证据让人与人之间的承诺更稳。

intro.en: Strengthen takes verb endings and is built on strength.
intro.cn: strengthen 加动词词尾，其基础是 strength。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin root; the word is Germanic.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词没有拉丁词根，属于日耳曼语来源。

items.meaning: to make a standing more secure
items.exampleCN: 这场胜利巩固了他的地位。

definition_en: worry caused by a difficult situation, special importance given to something, or the stronger sound in a word
core_image: 一根被拉紧的弦，绷得快要发出声音
scene: 考试前他感到很大压力。He felt a lot of stress before the exam.
sceneCN: 这里 stress 是「压力」（第 1 个义项）；句意：考试前他感到很大压力。

senses.title: Mental pressure
senses.definition: worry and tension caused by a difficult situation
senses.definitionCN: 困难处境造成的担忧与紧张
senses.example: He felt a lot of stress before the exam.
senses.exampleCN: 考试前他感到很大压力。
senses.why: This is pressure on the mind.
senses.whyCN: 这是压在心里的压力。

senses.title: Special emphasis
senses.definition: special importance given to something
senses.definitionCN: 给予某事物的特别重视
senses.example: The teacher stressed the need for rest.
senses.exampleCN: 老师强调了休息的必要。
senses.why: The mind presses on one point.
senses.whyCN: 心思在这里压住了一个重点。

senses.title: Strong sound
senses.definition: the stronger sound in a word or phrase
senses.definitionCN: 单词或短语中读得更强的音
senses.example: Put the stress on the first syllable.
senses.exampleCN: 把重音放在第一个音节上。
senses.why: Voice pressure marks the beat.
senses.whyCN: 声音的力度标出了节拍。

intro.en: Stress comes from distress, from Old French destrece, narrowness or hardship.
intro.cn: stress 由 distress 截短而来，源自法语 destrece，意为狭窄与艰难。

items.en: Strictus meant drawn tight.
items.cn: strictus 意为拉紧的。

items.en: Destrece named hardship and tightness.
items.cn: destrece 指艰难与紧绷。

items.en: Distresse named great trouble.
items.cn: 中古英语 distresse 指巨大的困苦。

items.en: Stress shortened the word and kept the pressure.
items.cn: stress 截短了词形，保留了压力之意。

items.en: It also named vocal emphasis.
items.cn: 它也开始指语音上的重音。

note.en: Stress is compared with look-alike words and with words for pressure.
note.cn: 把 stress 与形近词以及表示压力的词作比较。

entries.definition: force or worry pressing on someone

normalIntro.en: Stress is a tightened string, whether in the mind, the voice, or the sentence.
normalIntro.cn: stress 是一根绷紧的弦，可能在心里、在声音里，也可能在句子里。

normal.en: Too much stress harms sleep.
She stressed the value of teamwork.
normal.cn: 她强调了团队合作的价值。

normal.en: The word has stress on the second syllable.
normal.cn: 这个词的重音在第二个音节。

normal.en: He is under great stress at work.
normal.cn: 他工作时承受着巨大压力。

normal.en: Do not stress out over small things.

abstract.en: Stress is weight the mind puts on itself.
abstract.cn: 压力，是心给自己加的重量。

abstract.en: A stressed string can still make music.
abstract.cn: 绷紧的弦，依然能奏出音乐。

abstract.en: What we stress, we remember.
abstract.cn: 我们强调什么，就会记住什么。

examples.en: He felt a lot of stress before the exam.
examples.cn: 考试前他感到很大压力。

examples.en: The teacher stressed the need for rest.
examples.cn: 老师强调了休息的必要。

examples.en: Put the stress on the first syllable.
examples.cn: 把重音放在第一个音节上。

dict_mnemonic.text: stress 本义是「拉紧」；心里拉紧是压力，说话时把某点压重是强调，读音时把某个音节压重就是重音。

root: 源自拉丁语 strictus（拉紧），经法语 destrece 与中古英语 distresse 演变，截短为 stress；由紧绷与困苦，引申为心理压力、语义强调与语音重音。

sensesIntro.en: Stress is tension in the mind, weight on a point, and force in the voice.
sensesIntro.cn: stress 是心里的紧张、给某点的分量，以及声音里的力度。

core.en: A string pulled until it hums.
core.cn: 一根被拉到嗡嗡作响的弦。

branches.en: A student cannot sleep before the test.
A teacher repeats one key point.
One syllable sounds louder.
What we keep stressing becomes our worry.
branches.cn: 我们反复强调的东西，会变成忧虑。

branches.en: Emphasis in meaning lands as stress in sound.
branches.cn: 意思上的强调，落在声音上就是重音。

intro.en: Stress takes verb endings and builds adjective and noun forms.
intro.cn: stress 加动词词尾，并构成形容词与名词形式。

latinIntro.en: The Latin root is strictus, drawn tight.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁词根是 strictus，意为拉紧的。

items.example: The bank passed the stress test.
items.exampleCN: 这家银行通过了压力测试。

definition_en: to reach out your body, to spread over an area or time, or to pull something tight
core_image: 一个人双臂向上伸开，身体被拉得又长又直
scene: 她起床后伸了个懒腰。She stretched after getting out of bed.
sceneCN: 这里 stretch 是「伸展」（第 1 个义项）；句意：她起床后伸了个懒腰。

senses.title: Reach out the body
senses.definition: to extend your arms, legs, or body
senses.definitionCN: 伸开手臂、腿或身体
senses.example: She stretched after getting out of bed.
senses.exampleCN: 她起床后伸了个懒腰。
senses.why: This is the body making itself long.
senses.whyCN: 这是身体把自己拉长。

senses.title: Spread over an area
senses.definition: to continue over a distance or period
senses.definitionCN: 在空间或时间上延续
senses.example: The fields stretch for miles.
senses.exampleCN: 田野绵延数英里。
senses.why: The body's reach becomes the land's reach.
senses.whyCN: 身体的伸展变成了土地的伸展。

senses.title: Pull tight
senses.definition: to pull something so that it becomes tight or longer
senses.definitionCN: 把某物拉紧或拉长
senses.example: They stretched the rope across the river.
senses.exampleCN: 他们把绳子拉过河面。
senses.why: Here the pulling is done to an object.
senses.whyCN: 这个义项里，拉的动作落在物体上。

intro.en: Stretch comes from Old English streccan, to extend.
intro.cn: stretch 来自古英语 streccan，意为伸展。

items.en: Streccan meant to extend or reach out.
items.cn: streccan 意为伸展或伸出。

items.en: The root meant straight and stretched.
items.cn: 这个词根含有「直」与「拉长」之意。

items.en: Strecchen kept the sense of reaching.
items.cn: 中古英语 strecchen 仍指伸展。

items.en: Land and time could stretch too.
items.cn: 土地与时间也可以「延伸」。

items.en: At a stretch meant without a break.
items.cn: at a stretch 固定为连续不断之意。

note.en: Stretch is compared with look-alike words and with words for extending.
note.cn: 把 stretch 与形近词以及表示延伸的词作比较。

normalIntro.en: Stretch is length made on purpose, in a body, a road, or a rope.
normalIntro.cn: stretch 是刻意制造出来的长度，在身体、道路或绳子上都一样。

normal.en: Stretch your arms above your head.
The beach stretches along the coast.
We stopped to stretch our legs.
He stretched the rubber band.
She worked for hours at a stretch.
normal.cn: 她连续工作了好几个小时。

abstract.en: A stretch is a promise to become longer.
abstract.cn: 伸展，是一个变长的承诺。

abstract.en: Roads stretch because people need to arrive.
abstract.cn: 道路延伸，因为人需要抵达。

abstract.en: A stretched truth is thinner than it looks.
abstract.cn: 被拉长的事实，比看上去更薄。

examples.en: She stretched after getting out of bed.
examples.cn: 她起床后伸了个懒腰。

examples.en: The fields stretch for miles.
examples.cn: 田野绵延数英里。

examples.en: They stretched the rope across the river.
examples.cn: 他们把绳子拉过河面。

dict_mnemonic.text: stretch 的核心是「拉长」；身体拉长是伸展，土地拉长是延伸，绳子拉长是拉紧，说连续数小时就是 at a stretch。

intro.en: Stretch takes verb endings and builds adjectives and nouns.

She stretched out on the sofa.

definition_en: demanding that rules be obeyed, severe with people, or exact in meaning

senses.title: Demanding obedience

senses.title: Severe with people

senses.why: The rule now has a face.

senses.title: Exact in meaning

intro.en: Strict comes from Latin strictus, drawn tight.
intro.cn: strict 来自拉丁语 strictus，意为拉紧的。

items.en: Strictus meant drawn tight or narrow.

items.en: Strict described tight control.

items.en: It named rules that leave no room.

abstract.en: Strictness is a fence that remembers its line.

abstract.en: Exact words leave less room for trouble.
abstract.cn: 精确的话，给麻烦留的空间更少。

core.en: A ruler held against a hard edge.

branches.en: A late bell ends the argument.

A definition is read word by word.

branches.en: Rules become the voice that enforces them.

branches.en: A severe person and a strict reading both allow no slack.

items.example: In the strict sense, it is not a bird.

definition_en: in a way that demands rules be followed, or completely and exactly

scene: 这里严格禁止吸烟。Smoking is strictly forbidden here.

senses.title: According to rules

items.en: Strictus meant drawn tight.

items.en: Strict described tight control.

intro.en: Strike comes from Old English strican, to stroke or go.

normalIntro.en: Strip is a layer coming off, and what is left when it does.
normalIntro.cn: strip 是一层被去掉，也是去掉之后剩下的东西。

normal.en: He stripped the old paint off.
They stripped him of his rank.
A narrow strip of grass lined the road.
normal.cn: 路边有一条窄窄的草地。

normal.en: She read the comic strip in the paper.
normal.cn: 她读报纸上的连环漫画。

normal.en: The engine was stripped down for repair.

abstract.en: To strip is to find out what is underneath.
abstract.cn: 剥去，就是看看下面还有什么。

abstract.en: What is stripped away can be put back.
abstract.cn: 被剥掉的东西，还能装回去。

abstract.en: A thin strip is enough to mark a border.
abstract.cn: 窄窄一条，就足以标出边界。

examples.en: He stripped off his wet clothes.
examples.cn: 他脱掉湿衣服。

examples.en: The court stripped him of his title.
examples.cn: 法庭剥夺了他的头衔。

examples.en: A strip of land runs along the river.
examples.cn: 一条狭长的土地沿河延伸。

dict_mnemonic.text: strip 的核心是「去掉外层」；脱衣是脱去，剥漆是剥去，夺走头衔是剥夺，而剥下来的一条就是条带。

root: 来自中古英语 strippen（脱衣），与日耳曼语相关词同源；由去掉衣物与覆盖层，引申为剥夺权利，再由剥下的一层引申为条状物。

sensesIntro.en: Strip removes clothes or layers, takes away what someone has, or names a narrow band.
sensesIntro.cn: strip 去掉衣服或外层，夺走某人拥有的东西，也指一条窄带。

core.en: A layer peeled back from the top.
core.cn: 一层东西从顶部被剥开。

branches.en: Wet clothes fall to the floor.
A title is taken away.
A narrow field follows the river.
Clothes and honours can both be stripped.
branches.cn: 衣服与荣誉都可能被剥走。

branches.en: What is peeled off is itself a strip.
branches.cn: 被剥下来的东西，本身就是一条。

intro.en: Strip takes verb endings and builds adjective and noun forms.
intro.cn: strip 加动词词尾，并构成形容词与名词。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin root; the word is Germanic.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词没有拉丁词根，属于日耳曼语来源。

items.meaning: a tool or person that strips

items.example: A strip of land divides the fields.
items.exampleCN: 一条狭长土地隔开两片田野。

definition_zh: 条纹；斑纹；（军服上的）条纹
definition_en: a long narrow band of colour, a band on a uniform, or a kind or type of person
core_image: 斑马身上黑白相间的一道道长纹
scene: 斑马的条纹黑白相间。A zebra's stripes are black and white.
sceneCN: 这里 stripe 是「条纹」（第 1 个义项）；句意：斑马的条纹黑白相间。

senses.title: A band of colour
senses.definition: a long narrow band of colour different from what is around it
senses.definitionCN: 与周围颜色不同的一条窄带
senses.example: A zebra's stripes are black and white.
senses.exampleCN: 斑马的条纹黑白相间。
senses.why: This is the pattern you see.
senses.whyCN: 这是眼睛看到的图案。

senses.title: A mark of rank
senses.definition: a band worn on a uniform to show rank
senses.definitionCN: 制服上表示军衔的条纹
senses.example: The sergeant has three stripes.
senses.exampleCN: 这位中士有三道军衔条。
senses.why: A band of cloth becomes a mark of standing.
senses.whyCN: 一条布带成了身份的标记。

senses.title: A type of person
senses.definition: a kind or group, as in people of all stripes
senses.definitionCN: 某种类型或群体，如各种类型的人
senses.example: The club welcomes people of all stripes.
senses.exampleCN: 这个俱乐部欢迎各种各样的人。
senses.why: Different stripes mark different kinds.
senses.whyCN: 不同的条纹，标出不同的类别。

intro.en: Stripe comes from Middle English stripe, a band of colour.
intro.cn: stripe 来自中古英语 stripe，指一条色带。

items.en: Stripe named a narrow band.
items.cn: stripe 指一条窄带。

items.en: Related words named a line or stroke.
items.cn: 同源词表示线条或划痕。

items.en: Stripe described patterns on cloth and animals.
items.cn: stripe 描写布料与动物身上的花纹。

items.en: A uniform stripe marked rank.
items.cn: 制服上的条纹用来标示军衔。

items.en: Of all stripes came to mean of all kinds.
items.cn: of all stripes 引申为各种类型。

note.en: Stripe is compared with look-alike words and with words for lines and bands.
note.cn: 把 stripe 与形近词以及表示线条与色带的词作比较。

entries.definition: a long thin mark of colour

normalIntro.en: Stripe is a line of colour, a line of rank, or a line between kinds.
normalIntro.cn: stripe 是一道颜色的线、一道身份的线，或区分类型的线。

normal.en: The shirt has blue stripes.
Tigers have dark stripes.
He earned his stripes in the army.
normal.cn: 他在军队里凭本事获得了认可。

normal.en: Writers of all stripes attended.
normal.cn: 各种各样的作家都出席了。

normal.en: A white stripe runs down the road.

abstract.en: A stripe is a line that repeats.
abstract.cn: 条纹，是一条不断重复的线。

abstract.en: Every uniform tells its rank in lines.
abstract.cn: 每套制服都用线条说明身份。

abstract.en: Different stripes, same cloth.
abstract.cn: 条纹不同，布是一样的。

examples.en: A zebra's stripes are black and white.
examples.cn: 斑马的条纹黑白相间。

examples.en: The sergeant has three stripes.
examples.cn: 这位中士有三道军衔条。

examples.en: The club welcomes people of all stripes.
examples.cn: 这个俱乐部欢迎各种各样的人。

dict_mnemonic.text: stripe 是一条窄色带；动物和衣服上的是条纹，制服上的是军衔条，不同条纹也代指不同类型的人。

root: 来自中古英语 stripe（色带），与表示线条、划痕的日耳曼语词相关；由视觉上的条纹，引申为制服上的军衔标记，再比喻人的类型与派别。

sensesIntro.en: Stripe is a band of colour, a mark of rank, or a label for a kind of person.
sensesIntro.cn: stripe 是一条色带、一个身份标记，或某一类人的标签。

core.en: Dark lines running down a pale coat.
core.cn: 深色线条沿着浅色皮毛延伸。

branches.en: A zebra crosses the road.
A sleeve carries three bands.
A crowd gathers from many groups.
branches.cn: 人群来自许多不同的群体。

branches.en: A pattern on cloth can carry meaning.
branches.cn: 布上的图案也能承载意义。

branches.en: Stripes mark both rank and kind.
branches.cn: 条纹既标身份，也标类别。

intro.en: Stripe forms a plural and two adjectives.
intro.cn: stripe 有复数形式，并能构成两个形容词。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin root; the word is Germanic in origin.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词没有拉丁词根，源自日耳曼语。

items.example: A stripe of light crossed the floor.

items.exampleCN: 她很快凭本事获得了认可。

items.example: Readers of all stripes enjoy it.
items.exampleCN: 各种各样的读者都喜欢。

definition_en: a sudden illness in the brain, a gentle movement of the hand, a single movement in swimming, or a single hit
core_image: 一只手顺着猫背轻轻滑过，动作平缓而连续
scene: 他轻轻抚摸猫的背。He stroked the cat's back gently.
sceneCN: 这里 stroke 是「抚摸」（第 2 个义项）；句意：他轻轻抚摸猫的背。

senses.title: A brain illness
senses.definition: a sudden illness caused by blood not reaching the brain
senses.definitionCN: 血液无法到达脑部引起的突发疾病
senses.example: Her grandfather had a stroke last year.
senses.exampleCN: 她祖父去年中风了。
senses.why: This is the medical sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是医学上的义项。

senses.title: A gentle touch
senses.definition: a gentle movement of the hand over something
senses.definitionCN: 手在物体上轻柔地滑过
senses.example: He stroked the cat's back gently.
senses.exampleCN: 他轻轻抚摸猫的背。
senses.why: This is the hand moving smoothly.
senses.whyCN: 这是手平滑地移动。

senses.title: One movement
senses.definition: a single movement in swimming, rowing, or hitting
senses.definitionCN: 游泳、划桨或击打时的一个动作
senses.example: She swam fifty strokes across the pool.
senses.exampleCN: 她划了五十下横穿泳池。
senses.why: One sweep of the arm is one stroke.
senses.whyCN: 手臂扫过一次，就是一下。

intro.en: Stroke comes from Old English strac, a blow, and strican, to sweep.
intro.cn: stroke 来自古英语 strac（一击）与 strican（扫过）。

items.en: Strac named a blow or stroke.
items.cn: strac 指一击或一划。

items.en: The root named a quick sweeping movement.
items.cn: 这个词根表示快速扫过的动作。

items.en: Stroke meant a movement of the hand.
items.cn: 中古英语 stroke 指手的一次动作。

items.en: A stroke named one pull in rowing or swimming.
items.cn: stroke 指划船或游泳的一下。

items.en: The medical stroke described a sudden blow inside.
items.cn: 医学上的 stroke 描写体内突然的一击。

note.en: Stroke is compared with look-alike words and with words for touching.
note.cn: 把 stroke 与形近词以及表示触摸的词作比较。

entries.definition: to touch lightly with a flat hand

normalIntro.en: Stroke is one sweep of the hand, whether gentle or deadly.
normalIntro.cn: stroke 是手的一次扫过，可能温柔，也可能致命。

normal.en: She stroked the dog's head.
He suffered a stroke at work.
With one stroke, the problem was gone.
It was a stroke of luck.
The painter added a final stroke.

abstract.en: A gentle stroke can calm a wild heart.
abstract.cn: 轻轻一抚，能安抚一颗野性的心。

abstract.en: The same word holds a touch and a blow.
abstract.cn: 同一个词里，既有抚摸，也有重击。

abstract.en: One stroke of luck can change a whole year.
abstract.cn: 一次好运，能改变一整年。

examples.en: He stroked the cat's back gently.
examples.cn: 他轻轻抚摸猫的背。

examples.en: Her grandfather had a stroke last year.
examples.cn: 她祖父去年中风了。

examples.en: She swam fifty strokes across the pool.
examples.cn: 她划了五十下横穿泳池。

dict_mnemonic.text: stroke 本义是「一扫、一击」；手轻轻扫过是抚摸，手臂划一次是划水，体内突然一击是中风，运气突然来一下是 a stroke of luck。

root: 来自古英语 strac（一击）与 strican（扫过），属日耳曼语词；由一次扫过的动作，引申为抚摸、划水的一下、笔触，以及体内突发的病症。

sensesIntro.en: Stroke is a sudden illness, a soft sweep of the hand, or a single movement.
sensesIntro.cn: stroke 是一种突发疾病、手的一次轻抚，或一个单一的动作。

core.en: A hand passing once along a back.
core.cn: 一只手沿背部滑过一次。

branches.en: A patient loses speech suddenly.
A cat closes its eyes under a hand.
An arm pulls through water.
One smooth movement can comfort or carry.
branches.cn: 一次平滑的动作，能安抚，也能带人前行。

branches.en: A sudden stroke can stop the body's own strokes.
branches.cn: 突然的中风，能让身体的划动停下。

intro.en: Stroke takes verb endings and builds action and compound nouns.
intro.cn: stroke 加动词词尾，并构成动作名词与复合名词。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin root; the word is Germanic.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词没有拉丁词根，属于日耳曼语来源。

items.example: He had a stroke last winter.
The new law changed it at a stroke.
items.exampleCN: 新法律一下子改变了它。

items.example: Meeting her was a stroke of luck.

definition_en: having great physical power, great in degree or effect, or not easily broken
core_image: 一个人稳稳拉住绷紧的绳子，纹丝不动
scene: 他很强壮，能扛起那袋米。He is strong enough to carry the sack of rice.
sceneCN: 这里 strong 是「强壮的」（第 1 个义项）；句意：他很强壮，能扛起那袋米。

senses.title: Physically powerful
senses.definition: having great physical power
senses.definitionCN: 身体力量很大的
senses.example: He is strong enough to carry the sack of rice.
senses.exampleCN: 他很强壮，能扛起那袋米。
senses.why: This is power in the body.
senses.whyCN: 这是身体里的力量。

senses.title: Great in degree
senses.definition: great in force, taste, or feeling
senses.definitionCN: 在力度、味道或情感上很强的
senses.example: A strong wind blew all night.
senses.exampleCN: 强风吹了一整夜。
senses.why: The idea of force spreads to wind and taste.
senses.whyCN: 力量的概念扩展到了风和味道。

senses.title: Hard to break
senses.definition: solid and not easily broken or damaged
senses.definitionCN: 结实而不易损坏的
senses.example: The bridge is strong enough for trucks.
senses.exampleCN: 这座桥足够坚固，能承受卡车。
senses.why: A body's strength becomes a structure's.
senses.whyCN: 身体的强度变成了建筑的强度。

intro.en: Strong comes from Old English strang, powerful.
intro.cn: strong 来自古英语 strang，意为强大的。

items.en: Strang meant physically powerful.
items.cn: strang 意为身体强壮的。

items.en: The root also named tightness and severity.
items.cn: 这个词根也含有紧绷与严厉之意。

items.en: Strong kept the sense of power.
items.cn: 中古英语 strong 仍指力量。

items.en: Strong described wind, taste, and feelings.
items.cn: strong 开始形容风、味道与情感。

items.en: It also described solid structures.
items.cn: 它也用来形容坚固的结构。

note.en: Strong is compared with look-alike words and with words for power.
note.cn: 把 strong 与形近词以及表示强大的词作比较。

normalIntro.en: Strong is power you can see in an arm, feel in wind, or trust in a bridge.
normalIntro.cn: strong 是手臂上看得见的力量、风里感觉得到的力量，也是桥上可以依靠的力量。

normal.en: She is stronger than she looks.
A strong wind shook the windows.
He has strong opinions about food.
normal.cn: 他对食物有强烈的看法。

normal.en: Cooking is her strong point.
This coffee is too strong for me.
normal.cn: 这咖啡对我来说太浓了。

abstract.en: Strength is quiet until it is needed.
abstract.cn: 力量在需要之前，总是安静的。

abstract.en: A strong wind can move a strong tree.
abstract.cn: 强风能摇动坚固的树。

abstract.en: The strongest thing is often the most patient.
abstract.cn: 最强的东西，往往最有耐心。

examples.en: He is strong enough to carry the sack of rice.
examples.cn: 他很强壮，能扛起那袋米。

examples.en: A strong wind blew all night.
examples.cn: 强风吹了一整夜。

examples.en: The bridge is strong enough for trucks.
examples.cn: 这座桥足够坚固，能承受卡车。

dict_mnemonic.text: strong 的核心是「有力」；人有力量是强壮，风有力量是强烈，桥有力量是坚固，咖啡有力量是浓。

root: 来自古英语 strang（强大的），属日耳曼语词，与 strength、strengthen 同源；由身体的力量，扩展到风、味道、情感等强度，再指结构的坚固。

sensesIntro.en: Strong is power in a body, force in wind or taste, and firmness in a structure.
sensesIntro.cn: strong 是身体的力量、风与味道的强度，以及结构的坚固。

core.en: A rope held tight without shaking.
core.cn: 一根被拉紧却毫不抖动的绳。

branches.en: A worker lifts a heavy sack.
Branches bend in a gale.
A bridge carries trucks daily.
A strong body and a strong wind meet.
branches.cn: 强壮的身体遇上强劲的风。

branches.en: What is strong inside resists what is strong outside.
branches.cn: 内在坚固的，才扛得住外在强大的。

intro.en: Strong takes comparison and builds noun, adverb, and verb forms.
intro.cn: strong 有比较级，并构成名词、副词与动词。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin root; the word is Germanic.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词没有拉丁词根，属于日耳曼语来源。

items.example: He is the strongest of all.
items.exampleCN: 他是所有人中最强壮的。

definition_en: in a powerful way, with firm feeling, or in a solid manner
core_image: 一只手重重拍在桌上，把话说得毫不含糊
scene: 我强烈建议你早点出发。I strongly recommend that you leave early.
sceneCN: 这里 strongly 是「强烈地」（第 1 个义项）；句意：我强烈建议你早点出发。

senses.title: With firm feeling
senses.definition: in a firm and powerful way, as of opinion
senses.definitionCN: 以坚定有力的方式，如表达看法
senses.example: I strongly recommend that you leave early.
senses.exampleCN: 我强烈建议你早点出发。
senses.why: This is force in a statement.
senses.whyCN: 这是话语里的力度。

senses.title: In a solid way
senses.definition: in a solid or powerful physical way
senses.definitionCN: 以坚固或有力的物理方式
senses.example: The house is strongly built.
senses.exampleCN: 这房子建得很坚固。
senses.why: The same force now shows in structure.
senses.whyCN: 同样的力量此时体现在结构上。

intro.en: Strongly is strong plus the adverb ending -ly.
intro.cn: strongly 由 strong 加副词后缀 -ly 构成。

items.en: Strang meant powerful.
items.cn: strang 意为强大的。

items.en: Strong kept the sense of force.
items.cn: 中古英语 strong 仍指力量。

items.en: Strongly described powerful action.
items.cn: strongly 描写有力的动作。

items.en: It came to mark firm opinions.
items.cn: 它开始标示坚定的看法。

items.en: It also described solid construction.
items.cn: 也用来形容坚固的建造。

note.en: Strongly is compared with look-alike words and with words for firmness.
note.cn: 把 strongly 与形近词以及表示坚定的词作比较。

normalIntro.en: Strongly puts the weight of a strong word behind an action.
normalIntro.cn: strongly 把一个「强」字的重量压在动作后面。

normal.en: I strongly disagree with that.
She is strongly influenced by her teacher.
The bridge is strongly built.
He strongly believes in honesty.
They strongly supported the plan.
normal.cn: 他们大力支持这个计划。

abstract.en: A strongly held belief can steady a shaking day.
abstract.cn: 一个坚定的信念，能稳住摇晃的一天。

abstract.en: To say strongly is to put your weight behind a word.
abstract.cn: 说得强烈，就是把你的分量压在话上。

abstract.en: Built strongly, a thing can outlast its builder.
abstract.cn: 建得坚固，东西能比建造者活得更久。

examples.en: I strongly recommend that you leave early.
examples.cn: 我强烈建议你早点出发。

examples.en: The house is strongly built.
examples.cn: 这房子建得很坚固。

examples.en: She strongly believes in honesty.
examples.cn: 她坚信诚实。

dict_mnemonic.text: strongly 是 strong 加 -ly；看法有力是强烈地，建造有力是坚固地，核心都是把「强」用在动作上。

root: 由 strong（强壮的、有力的）加副词后缀 -ly 构成；strong 来自古英语 strang，因此 strongly 表示以强有力的方式，可用于意见、支持与建造。

sensesIntro.en: Strongly marks force in an opinion or solidity in a structure.
sensesIntro.cn: strongly 标示看法里的力度，或结构上的坚固。

core.en: A hand pressing a point home.
core.cn: 一只手把重点按实。

branches.en: A speaker repeats one clear word.
branches.cn: 发言者重复一个明确的词。

branches.en: A wall stands against the wind.
A friend gives firm support.
Strong words and strong walls both resist pressure.
branches.cn: 有力的话与坚固的墙，都抵得住压力。

branches.en: What is strongly made needs less repair.
branches.cn: 造得坚固的东西，需要修补得更少。

intro.en: Strongly is built from strong and adds no further endings.
intro.cn: strongly 由 strong 构成，本身不再加词尾。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin root; the word is Germanic.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词没有拉丁词根，属于日耳曼语来源。

items.exampleCN: 我们强烈建议早点预订。

definition_en: the way parts are arranged and joined, an organized system, or to arrange something in a planned way
core_image: 一座建筑的梁柱彼此咬合，撑起整体形状
scene: 这座桥的结构非常坚固。The structure of the bridge is very solid.
sceneCN: 这里 structure 是「结构」（第 1 个义项）；句意：这座桥的结构非常坚固。

senses.title: How parts are joined
senses.definition: the way the parts of something are arranged and joined
senses.definitionCN: 事物各部分排列与连接的方式
senses.example: The structure of the bridge is very solid.
senses.exampleCN: 这座桥的结构非常坚固。
senses.why: This is the shape held by parts.
senses.whyCN: 这是各部分撑起来的形状。

senses.title: An organized system
senses.definition: a system of parts that work together, as in society
senses.definitionCN: 各部分协同运作的体系，如社会
senses.example: The village has a simple social structure.
senses.exampleCN: 这个村子有简单的社会结构。
senses.why: Buildings and societies are both built.
senses.whyCN: 建筑与社会都是「搭」起来的。

senses.title: Arrange on purpose
senses.definition: to arrange something in a planned way
senses.definitionCN: 有计划地安排某事物
senses.example: She structured the report around three questions.
senses.exampleCN: 她围绕三个问题来组织这份报告。
senses.why: The noun becomes the act of building it.
senses.whyCN: 名词在这里变成了搭建的动作。

intro.en: Structure comes from Latin structura, a fitting together.
intro.cn: structure 来自拉丁语 structura，意为拼合、建造。

items.en: Structura meant building or arrangement.
items.cn: structura 意为建造或排列。

items.en: Struere meant to pile up or build.
items.cn: struere 意为堆起或建造。

items.en: Structure named a building's frame.
items.cn: 中古英语 structure 指建筑的骨架。

items.en: It described the parts of a whole.
items.cn: 它开始描述整体的各部分。

items.en: It also became a verb meaning to arrange.
items.cn: 它也变成动词，表示安排组织。

note.en: Structure is compared with look-alike words and with words for frameworks.
note.cn: 把 structure 与形近词以及表示框架的词作比较。

normalIntro.en: Structure is the order that holds parts together.
normalIntro.cn: structure 是把各部分拢在一起的那份秩序。

normal.en: The structure of the cell is simple.
normal.cn: 这个细胞的结构很简单。

normal.en: Social structure shapes daily life.
normal.cn: 社会结构塑造着日常生活。

normal.en: Check the sentence structure again.
They restructured the company.
She structured her speech clearly.
normal.cn: 她把演讲组织得很清楚。

abstract.en: Structure is a promise that parts will meet.
abstract.cn: 结构，是各部分终会相遇的承诺。

abstract.en: Remove one beam and the whole shape changes.
abstract.cn: 抽掉一根梁，整个形状就变了。

abstract.en: We build structures, and structures build us.
abstract.cn: 我们建造结构，结构也塑造我们。

examples.en: The structure of the bridge is very solid.
examples.cn: 这座桥的结构非常坚固。

examples.en: The village has a simple social structure.
examples.cn: 这个村子有简单的社会结构。

examples.en: She structured the report around three questions.
examples.cn: 她围绕三个问题来组织这份报告。

dict_mnemonic.text: structure 来自「建造」；梁柱怎么搭是结构，人与人的位置怎么排是体系，把事情按顺序搭好就是构建。

root: 来自拉丁语 structura（建造、拼合），源于 struere（堆起、建造）；由建筑的骨架，引申为事物各部分的组织方式，再扩大到社会体系与动词「构建」。

sensesIntro.en: Structure is how parts fit, a system of parts, or the act of arranging them.
sensesIntro.cn: structure 是各部分如何拼合、由部分组成的体系，或把部分安排好的动作。

core.en: Beams meeting at a firm joint.
core.cn: 梁木在牢固的接点相遇。

branches.en: A bridge holds its shape.
A village arranges its roles.
branches.cn: 村子安排着各自的角色。

branches.en: A writer orders three points.
A frame of wood and a frame of roles both hold.
branches.cn: 木头的框架与角色的框架，都能撑住。

branches.en: To structure is to choose an order.
branches.cn: 构建，就是选择一种顺序。

intro.en: Structure takes verb endings and builds adjective and verb forms.
intro.cn: structure 加动词词尾，并构成形容词与动词。

latinIntro.en: The Latin root is struere, to build, giving structura.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁词根是 struere（建造），名词为 structura。

definition_en: to fight hard against difficulty, or a hard fight or effort
core_image: 一个人在水里拼命划动双臂，向岸边靠近
scene: 他在水里挣扎着游向岸边。He struggled through the water toward the shore.
sceneCN: 这里 struggle 是「挣扎」（第 1 个义项）；句意：他在水里挣扎着游向岸边。

senses.title: Fight against difficulty
senses.definition: to use great effort against something difficult or dangerous
senses.definitionCN: 为对抗困难或危险而拼尽全力
senses.example: He struggled through the water toward the shore.
senses.exampleCN: 他在水里挣扎着游向岸边。
senses.why: This is effort against a force.
senses.whyCN: 这是与一股力量对抗所花的力气。

senses.title: A hard fight
senses.definition: a difficult fight or a long effort
senses.definitionCN: 艰难的斗争或长期的努力
senses.example: Losing the job was a real struggle for her.
senses.exampleCN: 失去工作对她来说是一段真正的艰难。
senses.why: The verb becomes the thing endured.
senses.whyCN: 动词在这里变成了所承受的事情。

senses.title: Have trouble doing
senses.definition: to find something very difficult to do
senses.definitionCN: 觉得某事非常难做
senses.example: He struggles with math.
senses.exampleCN: 他学数学很吃力。
senses.why: The fight is now with a task.
senses.whyCN: 这时的对手变成了一项任务。

intro.en: Struggle comes from Middle English strogelen, to fight hard.
intro.cn: struggle 来自中古英语 strogelen，意为奋力搏斗。

items.en: The word's exact source is not certain.
items.cn: 这个词的确切来源并不确定。

items.en: Strogelen meant to fight or strive.
items.cn: strogelen 意为搏斗或奋力。

items.en: Struggle described effort against danger.
items.cn: struggle 描写与危险对抗的努力。

items.en: It also named a long hard effort.
items.cn: 它也指长期艰苦的努力。

items.en: Struggle with came to mean having trouble.
items.cn: struggle with 引申为做某事很吃力。

note.en: Struggle is compared with look-alike words and with words for fighting hard.
note.cn: 把 struggle 与形近词以及表示奋力抗争的词作比较。

entries.definition: to fight a long hard fight

normalIntro.en: Struggle is effort that meets resistance and keeps going.
normalIntro.cn: struggle 是遇上阻力却仍继续的用力。

normal.en: She struggled to open the door.
Many families struggle with high rents.
normal.cn: 许多家庭在高房租下艰难生活。

normal.en: They struggled against the strong wind.
It was a long struggle for equality.
normal.cn: 那是为平等进行的长期斗争。

normal.en: He struggles with the new language.
normal.cn: 他学这门新语言很吃力。

abstract.en: A struggle is a door that does not open by itself.
abstract.cn: 挣扎，是一扇不会自己打开的门。

abstract.en: What resists you also teaches you.
abstract.cn: 让你受阻的东西，也在教你。

abstract.en: Small daily struggles build quiet strength.
abstract.cn: 每天的小挣扎，垒出安静的力量。

examples.en: He struggled through the water toward the shore.
examples.cn: 他在水里挣扎着游向岸边。

examples.en: Losing the job was a real struggle for her.
examples.cn: 失去工作对她来说是一段真正的艰难。

examples.en: He struggles with math.
examples.cn: 他学数学很吃力。

dict_mnemonic.text: struggle 的核心是「对抗着用力」；在水里对抗是挣扎，对命运长期用力是奋斗，面对难题吃力就是 struggle with。

root: 来自中古英语 strogelen（奋力搏斗），确切来源不确定；由身体上的挣扎，引申为长期的奋斗，再用于表示做某事很吃力。

sensesIntro.en: Struggle is effort against danger, a long hard fight, or trouble with a task.
sensesIntro.cn: struggle 是与危险对抗的力气、长期艰苦的斗争，或面对任务时的吃力。

core.en: Arms pushing against deep water.
core.cn: 手臂在深水中拼命划动。

branches.en: A swimmer fights the current.
A family endures a hard year.
branches.cn: 一家人熬过艰难的一年。

branches.en: A student stares at a hard problem.
One hard hour becomes a long fight.
branches.cn: 一个艰难的钟头，成了一场长久的斗争。

branches.en: What is hard to learn is also worth learning.

intro.en: Struggle takes verb endings and builds adjective and noun forms.
intro.cn: struggle 加动词词尾，并构成形容词与名词。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin root; the origin is uncertain but Germanic in shape.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词没有拉丁词根，来源不确定，但形态属日耳曼语。

items.exampleCN: 那家艰难度日的店关门了。
每个奋斗者都需要希望。

definition_en: a person who studies at a school or college, or someone who studies a subject seriously
core_image: 一个背着书包、抱着书走进教室的年轻人
scene: 她是本校的学生。She is a student at this school.
sceneCN: 这里 student 是「学生」（第 1 个义项）；句意：她是本校的学生。

senses.title: A person at school
senses.definition: someone who is studying at a school or college
senses.definitionCN: 在学校或大学学习的人
senses.example: She is a student at this school.
senses.exampleCN: 她是本校的学生。
senses.why: This is the everyday school sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是最日常的在校学生义项。

senses.title: A serious learner
senses.definition: someone who studies a subject with care and interest
senses.definitionCN: 认真钻研某一主题的人
senses.example: He is a student of ancient history.
senses.exampleCN: 他是研究古代史的学者。
senses.why: The role outlives the classroom.
senses.whyCN: 这个身份可以延续到教室之外。

intro.en: Student comes from Latin studium, eagerness or study.
intro.cn: student 来自拉丁语 studium，意为热忱或钻研。

items.en: Studium meant eager attention.
items.cn: studium 意为热切的专注。

items.en: Estudiant named a person who studies.
items.cn: estudiant 指学习的人。

items.en: Student named a learner at a school.
items.cn: 中古英语 student 指学校里的学习者。

items.en: It also named a careful researcher.
items.cn: 它也开始指认真的研究者。

items.en: Student life became a common phrase.
items.cn: student life 成为常用说法。

note.en: Student is compared with look-alike words and with words for learners.
note.cn: 把 student 与形近词以及表示学习者的词作比较。

normalIntro.en: A student is someone whose main work is learning.
normalIntro.cn: student 是把学习当作主要工作的人。

normal.en: The students filled the hall.
She is a college student.
Student life is busy but fun.
He is a student of human nature.
The exchange student arrived today.

abstract.en: Every student is a beginner with a future.
abstract.cn: 每个学生，都是带着未来的初学者。

abstract.en: To stay curious is to stay a student.
abstract.cn: 保持好奇，就一直是学生。

abstract.en: The best students keep asking why.
abstract.cn: 最好的学生一直在问为什么。

examples.en: She is a student at this school.
examples.cn: 她是本校的学生。

examples.en: He is a student of ancient history.
examples.cn: 他是研究古代史的学者。

examples.en: The exchange student arrived today.
examples.cn: 交换生今天到了。

dict_mnemonic.text: student 与 study 同源，核心是「用心钻研的人」；在学校读书的是学生，把某个领域钻研一辈子的是研究者。

root: 来自拉丁语 studium（热忱、钻研），经古法语 estudiant 进入英语；由用心学习的人，引申为对某一领域认真研究的人。

sensesIntro.en: Student names a learner at school, and also a serious student of a subject.
sensesIntro.cn: student 指学校里的学习者，也指认真研究某一主题的人。

core.en: A bag of books on a young shoulder.
core.cn: 年轻肩膀上的一包书。

branches.en: A class begins at eight.
A researcher reads old papers.
A pupil raises a hand.
The classroom is the first laboratory.
A student of anything never stops asking.
branches.cn: 任何领域的钻研者，都不会停止发问。

intro.en: Student forms a plural and connects to study and studious.
intro.cn: student 有复数，并与 study、studious 相连。

latinIntro.en: The Latin root is studium, eager study.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁词根是 studium，意为热切的钻研。

items.exampleCN: 一位交换生加入了我们。

definition_zh: 工作室；演播室；单间公寓
definition_en: a room where an artist works, a place where films or programmes are made, or a small flat with one main room
core_image: 一间大窗明亮的房间，画架、灯光和工具各就各位
scene: 画家在她的工作室里作画。The painter works in her studio.
sceneCN: 这里 studio 是「工作室」（第 1 个义项）；句意：画家在她的工作室里作画。

senses.title: An artist's room
senses.definition: a room where an artist or photographer works
senses.definitionCN: 艺术家或摄影师工作的房间
senses.example: The painter works in her studio.
senses.exampleCN: 画家在她的工作室里作画。
senses.why: This is a room made for making.
senses.whyCN: 这是一个为创作而设的房间。

senses.title: A production room
senses.definition: a place where films, music, or programmes are recorded
senses.definitionCN: 录制电影、音乐或节目的场所
senses.example: The band recorded the song in a studio.
senses.exampleCN: 乐队在录音棚里录了这首歌。
senses.why: Cameras and microphones need a controlled room.
senses.whyCN: 摄像机和麦克风需要一个可控的房间。

senses.title: A small flat
senses.definition: a small flat with one main room
senses.definitionCN: 只有一个主要房间的小公寓
senses.example: She rents a studio near the station.
senses.exampleCN: 她在车站附近租了一间单间公寓。
senses.why: One room serves for living and working.
senses.whyCN: 一个房间兼作起居与工作。

intro.en: Studio comes from Italian studio, a room for study or art.
intro.cn: studio 来自意大利语 studio，意为学习或创作之室。

items.en: Studium meant eager study.
items.cn: studium 意为热切的钻研。

items.en: Studio named a study or workroom.
items.cn: studio 指书房或工作室。

items.en: Studio named an artist's workroom.
items.cn: studio 指艺术家的工作室。

items.en: It moved into film and music production.
items.cn: 它进入电影与音乐制作领域。

items.en: It also named a one-room flat.
items.cn: 它也指只有一个房间的公寓。

note.en: Studio is compared with look-alike words and with words for workrooms.
note.cn: 把 studio 与形近词以及表示工作场所的词作比较。

normalIntro.en: Studio is a room where making happens, from paint to film to living.
normalIntro.cn: studio 是让创作发生的房间，从颜料到电影，再到生活。

normal.en: The artist cleaned her studio.
They built a new film studio.
normal.cn: 他们建了新的电影制片厂。

normal.en: The song was recorded in a studio.
He lives in a small studio.
normal.cn: 他住在一间小单间公寓里。

normal.en: The TV studio was full of lights.

abstract.en: A studio is a room that listens to its worker.
abstract.cn: 工作室，是一间听工作者话的房间。

abstract.en: One room can hold both a bed and a beginning.
abstract.cn: 一个房间，能同时装下床和起点。

abstract.en: Every finished work leaves a studio behind.
abstract.cn: 每件完成的作品背后，都有一间工作室。

examples.en: The painter works in her studio.
examples.cn: 画家在她的工作室里作画。

examples.en: The band recorded the song in a studio.
examples.cn: 乐队在录音棚里录了这首歌。

examples.en: She rents a studio near the station.
examples.cn: 她在车站附近租了一间单间公寓。

dict_mnemonic.text: studio 原指「钻研之室」；画家在里面作画是工作室，乐队在里面录音是录音棚，一个人住在里面就是单间公寓。

root: 来自意大利语 studio（书房、工作室），源于拉丁语 studium（钻研）；由艺术家的创作房间，扩展到影视与音乐制作场所，再指一室一厅的小公寓。

sensesIntro.en: Studio is an artist's room, a recording room, or a one-room home.
sensesIntro.cn: studio 是艺术家的房间、录制节目的房间，或只有一个房间的家。

core.en: A bright room with tools laid out.
core.cn: 一间摆好工具、光线明亮的房间。

branches.en: A brush rests beside a canvas.
A microphone hangs from the ceiling.
A bed and a desk share one room.
branches.cn: 床和书桌共用一个房间。

branches.en: Both art and sound need a controlled room.
branches.cn: 艺术与声音都需要一个可控的房间。

branches.en: A small studio can still hold big work.
branches.cn: 小小的工作室，也能装下大作品。

intro.en: Studio forms a plural and compounds for flats.
intro.cn: studio 有复数形式，并能构成公寓相关复合词。

latinIntro.en: The Latin source is studium, through Italian studio.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语来源是 studium，经意大利语 studio 进入英语。

items.example: The studios are on this street.
The art studio smells of paint.

items.meaning: a place where films are made

items.example: The TV studio has three cameras.
A studio apartment suits one person.
items.exampleCN: 单间公寓适合一个人住。

latinEntries.meaning: to learn, or a room for it

definition_en: to learn about a subject, to examine something carefully, or a room used for reading and writing
core_image: 一盏台灯下摊开的书，旁边放着写满字的笔记本
scene: 她每天晚上学习两个小时。She studies for two hours every evening.
sceneCN: 这里 study 是「学习」（第 1 个义项）；句意：她每天晚上学习两个小时。

senses.title: Learn a subject
senses.definition: to spend time learning about a subject
senses.definitionCN: 花时间学习某一科目
senses.example: She studies for two hours every evening.
senses.exampleCN: 她每天晚上学习两个小时。
senses.why: This is the everyday learning sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是最日常的学习义项。

senses.title: Examine carefully
senses.definition: to examine something carefully to understand it
senses.definitionCN: 仔细考察某事物以理解它
senses.example: The team studied the problem for weeks.
senses.exampleCN: 团队研究这个问题研究了好几个星期。
senses.why: Learning turns outward to the world.
senses.whyCN: 学习在这里转向了外部世界。

senses.title: A reading room
senses.definition: a room in a house used for reading and writing
senses.definitionCN: 家中用于读书写作的房间
senses.example: He keeps his books in the study.
senses.exampleCN: 他把书放在书房里。
senses.why: The action gets a room of its own.
senses.whyCN: 这个动作有了自己的房间。

intro.en: Study comes from Latin studium, eagerness, through Old French.
intro.cn: study 来自拉丁语 studium（热忱），经古法语进入英语。

items.en: Studium meant eager effort.
items.cn: studium 意为热切的努力。

items.en: Estudie named study and care.
items.cn: estudie 指钻研与用心。

items.en: Studie meant to learn or examine.
items.cn: 中古英语 studie 意为学习或考察。

items.en: Study also named a room for books.
items.cn: study 也指放书的房间。

items.en: Case study named a close examination.
items.cn: case study 指个案研究。

note.en: Study is compared with look-alike words and with words for learning.
note.cn: 把 study 与形近词以及表示学习的词作比较。

normalIntro.en: Study is effort turned toward knowledge, and the room that holds it.
normalIntro.cn: study 是朝向知识的用力，也是容纳这份用力的房间。

normal.en: He studies history at university.
We studied the map before leaving.
normal.cn: 出发前我们研究了地图。

normal.en: She studies hard for exams.
The report is a case study.
normal.cn: 这份报告是一个个案研究。

normal.en: The study was warm and quiet.

abstract.en: Study is a conversation with people you never meet.
abstract.cn: 学习，是和从未谋面的人交谈。

abstract.en: The more we study, the more we see.
abstract.cn: 研究得越多，看见的就越多。

abstract.en: A quiet room can hold a loud idea.
abstract.cn: 安静的房间，能装下响亮的思想。

examples.en: She studies for two hours every evening.
examples.cn: 她每天晚上学习两个小时。

examples.en: The team studied the problem for weeks.
examples.cn: 团队研究这个问题研究了好几个星期。

examples.en: He keeps his books in the study.
examples.cn: 他把书放在书房里。

dict_mnemonic.text: study 的核心是「用心钻研」；在学校用心是学习，对一个问题用心是研究，专门用来用心的房间就是书房。

root: 来自拉丁语 studium（热忱、钻研），经古法语 estudie 进入英语；由学习与考察的动作，引申为研究，再指家中读书写作的书房。

sensesIntro.en: Study is learning, careful research, or the room where both happen.
sensesIntro.cn: study 是学习、仔细研究，或让这两件事发生的书房。

core.en: A lamp, a book, and a page filling with notes.
core.cn: 一盏灯、一本书、一页渐渐写满的笔记。

branches.en: A student reads until midnight.
A team checks every detail.
Books line a quiet room.
branches.cn: 书排满一间安静的房间。

branches.en: Reading turns into finding out.
The room and the work share a name.
branches.cn: 房间与工作共用一个名字。

intro.en: Study takes verb endings and builds noun, adjective, and adverb forms.
intro.cn: study 加动词词尾，并构成名词、形容词与副词。

latinIntro.en: The Latin root is studium, eager effort.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁词根是 studium，意为热切的努力。

items.meaning: a close study of one case
items.exampleCN: 他们写了一份个案研究。

definition_en: things in general, the material something is made of, or to fill something tightly
core_image: 一个塞得鼓鼓的背包，里面装着各种说不上名字的东西
scene: 他把衣服塞进背包里。He stuffed his clothes into the backpack.
sceneCN: 这里 stuff 是「填塞」（第 3 个义项）；句意：他把衣服塞进背包里。

senses.title: Things in general
senses.definition: a word for things when the exact name is not needed
senses.definitionCN: 不必说出确切名称时对物品的统称
senses.example: Put your stuff in the corner.
senses.exampleCN: 把你的东西放到角落里。
senses.why: This is the catch-all noun.
senses.whyCN: 这是包罗万象的名词。

senses.title: Material
senses.definition: the substance something is made of
senses.definitionCN: 构成某物的物质
senses.example: This stuff feels like wool.
senses.exampleCN: 这种材料摸起来像羊毛。
senses.why: The general noun becomes a substance.
senses.whyCN: 笼统的名词在这里变成了具体的物质。

senses.title: Fill tightly
senses.definition: to fill something tightly with things
senses.definitionCN: 把东西紧紧地塞进某物
senses.example: He stuffed his clothes into the backpack.
senses.exampleCN: 他把衣服塞进背包里。
senses.why: Material pressed into a space becomes a verb.
senses.whyCN: 把材料压进空间，就成了动词。

intro.en: Stuff comes from Old French estoffe, material or cloth.
intro.cn: stuff 来自古法语 estoffe，意为材料或布料。

items.en: Estoffe meant material or supplies.
items.cn: estoffe 意为材料或物资。

items.en: Stuff named cloth and goods.
items.cn: 中古英语 stuff 指布料与货物。

items.en: Stuff widened to mean things in general.
items.cn: stuff 扩展为泛指各种东西。

items.en: To stuff meant to fill tightly.
items.cn: to stuff 表示紧紧填满。

items.en: Stuffed animals named toys filled with soft material.
items.cn: stuffed animals 指填了软材料的玩具。

note.en: Stuff is compared with look-alike words and with words for things and filling.
note.cn: 把 stuff 与形近词以及表示东西与填充的词作比较。

entries.definition: hard and not easy to bend

normalIntro.en: Stuff is a word for what we have not named, and then for pushing it in.
normalIntro.cn: stuff 先是我们叫不出名字的东西，然后是把这些东西塞进去。

normal.en: My stuff is in the car.
What is this stuff on the table?
She stuffed the bag with books.
He really knows his stuff.
The child hugged a stuffed bear.

abstract.en: Stuff is what remains when names run out.
abstract.cn: 叫不出名字时，剩下的就叫 stuff。

abstract.en: A full bag is a small argument with space.
abstract.cn: 塞满的包，是和空间的一场小争执。

abstract.en: Knowing your stuff needs no loud voice.
abstract.cn: 真懂本行的人，不必大声。

examples.en: He stuffed his clothes into the backpack.
examples.cn: 他把衣服塞进背包里。

examples.en: Put your stuff in the corner.
examples.cn: 把你的东西放到角落里。

examples.en: This stuff feels like wool.
examples.cn: 这种材料摸起来像羊毛。

dict_mnemonic.text: stuff 本指「材料、布料」；后来泛指叫不出名字的东西，再变成动词，表示把东西紧紧塞进去。

root: 来自古法语 estoffe（材料、物资），经中古英语进入英语；由布料与材料，扩展为对物品的统称，再引申为把东西填塞进去的动作。

sensesIntro.en: Stuff is unnamed things, the material they are made of, or the act of filling a space with them.
sensesIntro.cn: stuff 是叫不出名字的东西、构成它们的材料，或把它们塞满空间的动作。

core.en: A backpack bulging with unnamed things.
core.cn: 一个被无名之物撑鼓的背包。

branches.en: A pile of belongings waits by the door.
A hand feels the cloth.
Clothes are pushed into a bag.
Things are made of some material.
branches.cn: 东西总是由某种材料做成。

branches.en: Material is what gets stuffed.

intro.en: Stuff takes verb endings and builds noun and adjective forms.
intro.cn: stuff 加动词词尾，并构成名词与形容词。

latinIntro.en: The source is Old French estoffe, not Latin.
latinIntro.cn: 来源是古法语 estoffe，而不是拉丁语。

items.meaning: not fresh, hard to breathe in

items.example: The child loves her stuffed animal.
items.exampleCN: 孩子很喜欢她的毛绒玩具。
